XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: 4. Sut mae'r Llywodraeth yn sicrhau bod cyfranogiad mewn chwaraeon yn hygyrch i bawb yn Afan Ogwr Rhondda? OQ64712
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: 4. How is the Government ensuring that participation in sport is accessible to all in Afan Ogwr Rhondda? OQ64712

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch i'r Aelod am y cwestiwn. Rydyn ni'n gweithio drwy Chwaraeon Cymru a phartneriaid lleol i wneud chwaraeon yn hygyrch i bawb yn Afan Ogwr Rhondda. Rydw i eisoes wedi sôn bod yna heriau a rhwystrau'n bodoli, a drwy'r strategaeth diwylliant a chwaraeon newydd, dŷn ni eisiau mynd i'r afael efo'r rhwystrau hynny.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: I thank the Member for the question. We are working through Sport Wales and local partners to make sport accessible to everyone in Afan Ogwr Rhondda. I have already mentioned that there are challenges and barriers in place, and through the new culture and sport strategy, we want to address those barriers.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch, Weinidog. A dylwn i fod wedi dechrau trwy ddweud, 'Shwmae?'
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Thank you, Minister. I should've started by saying, 'Shwmae?'

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Minister, the programme for government commits to prioritising equality of access to sport for people of all ages, backgrounds and abilities, as well as increasing participation and improving grass-roots facilities. Back in June, I had the opportunity to visit the Margam Stags inclusion football festival, bringing together children and young people of different ages and abilities. The Margam Football Club Inclusion Stags are well known in my constituency for the invaluable opportunities they provide for people who might otherwise face significant barriers to taking part in sport.

I also recently visited Afan United's brand-new facilities in Sandfields, where a major investment has transformed the site into a high-quality community football hub. This has put modern sporting facilities right on the doorstep of a community where levels of deprivation are high. These are the kinds of projects that can make equality of access a reality and give young people opportunities they might not otherwise have had. Minister, how will the Government ensure that its commitment to improve grass-roots facilities is targeted towards those communities and groups where barriers to participation are greatest?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Weinidog, mae’r rhaglen lywodraethu’n ymrwymo i flaenoriaethu mynediad cyfartal at chwaraeon i bobl o bob oed, cefndir a gallu, yn ogystal â chynyddu cyfranogiad a gwella cyfleusterau llawr gwlad. Ym mis Mehefin, cefais gyfle i ymweld â gŵyl bêl-droed gynhwysol Margam Stags, sy'n dod â phlant a phobl ifanc o wahanol oedrannau a galluoedd ynghyd. Mae Clwb Pêl-droed Margam Stags yn adnabyddus yn fy etholaeth am y cyfleoedd gwerthfawr y maent yn eu darparu i bobl a allai wynebu rhwystrau sylweddol fel arall i gymryd rhan mewn chwaraeon.

Yn ddiweddar, ymwelais hefyd â chyfleusterau newydd sbon Afan United yn Sandfields, lle mae buddsoddiad sylweddol wedi trawsnewid y safle’n hyb pêl-droed cymunedol o ansawdd uchel. Mae hyn wedi rhoi cyfleusterau chwaraeon modern ar garreg y drws mewn cymuned lle mae lefelau amddifadedd yn uchel. Dyma'r math o brosiectau a all wireddu mynediad cyfartal a rhoi cyfleoedd i bobl ifanc na fyddent efallai wedi'u cael fel arall. Weinidog, sut y bydd y Llywodraeth yn sicrhau bod ei hymrwymiad i wella cyfleusterau llawr gwlad yn cael ei dargedu at y cymunedau a'r grwpiau lle mae'r rhwystrau mwyaf rhag gallu cymryd rhan?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Diolch i'r Aelod am y cwestiwn ychwanegol hwnnw. Mae'n wych clywed am y prosiectau pwysig yma sydd yn digwydd rŵan, ac un o'r pethau dwi'n gobeithio y byddwch chi ac Aelodau eraill yn ei wneud, drwy'r alwad am dystiolaeth, ydy gyrru esiamplau lle mae hyn yn digwydd. Dydy o ddim yn rhywbeth a all ddigwydd yn y dyfodol, mae o'n digwydd yn ein cymunedau ni rŵan. Ond mae yna risg, heb fuddsoddiad, na fydd y gwaith hwnnw'n ddigwydd, a hefyd, fel dŷch chi wedi sôn, fod yna anghyfartaledd, oherwydd os nad ydych chi efo'r grŵp hwnnw, yna does yna ddim cyfle i gyfranogi.

Felly, mae'n bwysig ein bod ni'n dysgu o'r esiamplau hynny sydd yn gweithio a'n bod ni'n edrych wedyn ar sut mae hynny'n dyblygu ac yn dyblygu mewn ffordd sydd yn gweithio i'r gymuned honno, oherwydd mi fydd pob cymuned yn wahanol o ran y datrysiadau. Ond yn sicr, dyna'r math o dystiolaeth dŷn ni'n ei chasglu ar y funud. Dwi wastad yn barod iawn i ymweld efo unrhyw esiamplau hefyd; dwi'n agor fy hun i fyny am wahoddiadau pellach.

Ond mae'n bwysig hefyd ein bod ni'n uwcholeuo'r cyfleoedd sydd eisoes yn bodoli, oherwydd nid yw rhai pobl yn gwybod beth sydd ar gael yn eu cymunedau nhw. Felly, mae yna rôl i ni i gyd hefyd fod yn defnyddio'r platfformau sydd gennym ni i rannu'r wybodaeth honno. Mae yna fwy y medrwn ni ei wneud hefyd drwy bethau fel social prescribing i fod yn annog y rheini sydd yn dal i'w chael hi'n anodd, hyd yn oed pan mae'r math yna o gyfleuster ar gael yn lleol.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
I thank the Member for that supplementary question. It's great to hear about the important projects that are currently proceeding, and one of the things that I hope that you and other Members will do, through that call for evidence, is to provide those examples where this is happening. It's not something that can happen in the future, it is already happening in our communities. But there is a risk that, without investment, that work won't continue, and also, as you mentioned, that there is an inequality of access, because if you don't have that group, then you don't have an opportunity to participate. 

So, it's important that we learn from those examples that work, and then we look at how that can be duplicated in a way that works for that community, because all communities will be different in terms of solutions. But certainly, that's the kind of evidence that we are gathering at the moment. I'm always willing to visit any examples; I am opening myself up to further invitations here.

But it is also important that we highlight the opportunities that already exist, because some people simply aren't aware of what's available in their communities. So, there is a role for us too to be using our platforms in order to share that information. There is more that we can do too through things like social prescribing in order to encourage those who find it difficult, even when that kind of facility or provision is available locally.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch, Deputy Llywydd. Cabinet Minister, accessible sport means good facilities close to home, with affordable, fair access to every club, school and girls' team. I welcome your expansion support for artificial pitches. In May 2024, the then Cabinet Secretary told this Chamber that the Rhondda third generation facility was a Welsh Rugby Union priority, with Coleg y Cymoedd identified as a potential solution. She urged partners to work towards applying in the following financial year. More than two years on, our community needs a clear route forward. Will you confirm whether an application has been submitted for that proposal, and whether this year's funding could support a modern fourth generation all-weather rugby pitch that meets the required standards for training and competitive matches while the Sport Wales audit proceeds? Diolch.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Diolch, Ddirprwy Lywydd. Weinidog Cabinet, mae chwaraeon hygyrch yn golygu cyfleusterau da yn agos at adref, gyda mynediad fforddiadwy a theg i bob clwb, ysgol a thîm merched. Rwy'n croesawu eich cefnogaeth i ehangu nifer y caeau artiffisial. Ym mis Mai 2024, dywedodd Ysgrifennydd y Cabinet ar y pryd wrth y Siambr hon fod cyfleuster 3G y Rhondda yn flaenoriaeth i Undeb Rygbi Cymru, gyda Choleg y Cymoedd wedi'i nodi fel ateb posibl. Anogodd bartneriaid i weithio tuag at gyflwyno cais yn y flwyddyn ariannol ganlynol. Dros ddwy flynedd yn ddiweddarach, mae angen llwybr clir ymlaen ar ein cymuned. A wnewch chi gadarnhau p’un a oes cais wedi'i gyflwyno ar gyfer y cynnig hwnnw, ac a allai cyllid eleni gefnogi cae rygbi 4G modern sy'n addas ar gyfer pob tywydd ac yn bodloni'r safonau gofynnol ar gyfer hyfforddiant a gemau cystadleuol tra bod archwiliad Chwaraeon Cymru yn parhau? Diolch.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Thank you for your question. I don't know, but I will endeavour to find out what the situation is. You will also appreciate that it was a different party and a different Minister that gave that response at that time, but I'm happy to follow up and ensure you receive that response.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Diolch am eich cwestiwn. Nid wyf yn gwybod, ond fe geisiaf gael gwybod beth yw'r sefyllfa. Fe fyddwch chi hefyd yn deall mai plaid wahanol a Gweinidog gwahanol a roddodd yr ymateb hwnnw ar y pryd, ond rwy'n hapus i ymchwilio ymhellach a sicrhau eich bod yn cael yr ymateb hwnnw.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Esports

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: 5. Beth mae Llywodraeth Cymru yn ei wneud i hyrwyddo twf e-chwaraeon yng Nghymru? OQ64683
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: 5. What is the Welsh Government doing to promote the growth of esports in Wales? OQ64683

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Mae Cymru Greadigol wedi cefnogi Esports Wales i ddatblygu sgiliau a llwybrau gyrfaol creadigol sy'n gysylltiedig ag e-chwaraeon. Rydyn ni'n ystyried cynigion ar gyfer buddsoddiad economaidd mewn e-chwaraeon wrth iddynt godi, a dŷn ni'n parhau i gefnogi diwydiant gemau fideo ehangach Cymru drwy gyllid datblygu a chynhyrchu, rhaglenni sgiliau a chyfleoedd masnach. Er enghraifft, ym mis Medi mi aethon ni â dirprwyaeth o wyth o ddatblygwyr gemau o Gymru i'r Tokyo Game Show. Ond fel clywsoch chi yn fy ymateb i Mike Hedges yn gynharach, mae yna fwy, dwi'n credu, y gallem ni fod yn ei wneud, a byddwn ni'n edrych ar hwn fel datblygiad strategaeth newydd.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Creative Wales have supported Esports Wales to develop skills and creative career pathways linked to esports. We actively consider proposals for economic investment in esports as they arise, and we continue to support Wales’s wider video games industry through development and production funding, skills programmes and trade opportunities. For example, in September we took a delegation of eight Welsh games developers to the Tokyo Game Show. But as you heard in my response to Mike Hedges earlier on today, there is more that I believe we could be doing, and we will be looking into this as we develop a new strategy.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Thank you. Esports is something that I'm deeply passionate about, and I didn't expect, before coming down to the Chamber today, to be beaten to the post by the Labour spokesman on this issue, but I'm glad that it has happened. One area that I'd like to talk about is the benefits that esports events could bring to Wales. Stockton University in the United States described esports tournaments and events as 'the untapped tourism opportunity'. The Greater London Authority recently estimated that a single esports event, the 2025 BLAST Premier London Open, generated more than £30 million of economic impact for the city. Now, the mayor of London has recently set out an ambition to put London at the heart of global esports, and I see no reason why we shouldn't have a similar ambition here in Wales so that we can enjoy the benefits of this growing industry. So, will you commit today to take positive action to help attract more esports events to Wales? Diolch.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Diolch. Mae gennyf ddiddordeb brwd iawn mewn e-chwaraeon, a chyn dod i'r Siambr heddiw, nid oeddwn yn disgwyl y byddai llefarydd y Blaid Lafur ar y mater hwn yn achub y blaen arnaf, ond rwy'n falch fod hynny wedi digwydd. Un maes yr hoffwn sôn amdano yw'r manteision y gallai digwyddiadau e-chwaraeon eu cynnig i Gymru. Disgrifiodd Prifysgol Stockton yn yr Unol Daleithiau bencampwriaethau a digwyddiadau e-chwaraeon fel cyfle twristiaeth nad aethpwyd ar ei drywydd hyd yma. Amcangyfrifodd Awdurdod Llundain Fwyaf yn ddiweddar fod un digwyddiad e-chwaraeon, sef BLAST Premier London Open 2025, wedi creu effaith economaidd o fwy na £30 miliwn i'r ddinas. Nawr, mae maer Llundain wedi amlinellu uchelgais yn ddiweddar i roi Llundain wrth wraidd y maes e-chwaraeon yn fyd-eang, ac ni welaf unrhyw reswm pam na ddylem ni hefyd gael uchelgais tebyg yma yng Nghymru er mwyn i ni allu mwynhau manteision y diwydiant hwn sy'n tyfu. Felly, a wnewch chi ymrwymo heddiw i roi camau cadarnhaol ar waith i helpu i ddenu mwy o ddigwyddiadau e-chwaraeon i Gymru? Diolch.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch am y cwestiwn. Dwi'n credu bod yna grŵp trawsbleidiol newydd yn mynd i gael ei ddechrau ar esports. Mae gennym ni ddwy blaid eisoes wedi ymrwymo i hynny, a gobeithio bod y sicrwydd dwi wedi ei roi fy mod i'n cydnabod y gallem ni fod yn gwneud mwy o ran esports yng Nghymru—. Dwi'n cytuno efo hynny, a dwi'n awyddus iawn i glywed syniadau gan unrhyw Aelodau o ran sut y byddem ni'n gallu ymgorffori hynny o fewn strategaeth newydd.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Thank you for the question. I believe that there's a new cross-party group going to be set up on esports. We have two parties here who have already committed to that, and hopefully the assurance I've given you that I recognise that we could be doing more in terms of esports in Wales—. I agree with that, and I am very keen to hear ideas from any Members in terms of how we could incorporate that within a new strategy.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Nofio a Diogelwch Dŵr
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Swimming and Water Safety

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: 6. A wnaiff y Gweinidog Cabinet roi diweddariad ar y rhaglen genedlaethol newydd nofio a diogelwch dŵr i ysgolion? OQ64701
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: 6. Will the Cabinet Minister provide an update on the new national school swimming and water safety programme? OQ64701

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch i'r Aelod. Mae Nofio Ysgol yn rhaglen genedlaethol newydd ar gyfer nofio a diogelwch dŵr ysgolion, sy'n darparu cynnig cenedlaethol cyson o o leiaf 20 o wersi nofio a diogelwch dŵr i ddisgyblion blynyddoedd 4 a 5. Mi ddechreuodd y gwaith hwn mewn naw awdurdod lleol yn barod ym mis Medi, gan nodi cam cyntaf y cyflwyniad fydd wedyn ledled Cymru.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: I thank the Member. Nofio Ysgol is our new national school swimming and water safety programme, providing pupils in years 4 and 5 with a consistent national offer of at least 20 swimming and water safety lessons. This work began in nine local authorities in September, marking the first phase of a planned Wales-wide roll-out.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Learning to swim is one of the best gifts you can give a child. I have had the privilege of swimming in the Hampstead Heath ponds, the Serpentine, Lake Bled, off the Isle of Skye and a good deal of the west coast, and one day I'm going to do a swimathon again. It is a skill that you can keep for life, takes you to places you would never dream of and takes you around the world. But not every child has the benefit of that kind of start. Swim Wales found that only 42 per cent of children in years 3 to 6 could swim 25m unaided, which is a serious figure for a country with our coastline, and it's also a safety issue. So, I welcome this programme, but could the Cabinet Minister please outline how it will get to grips with teaching children in areas where there is little provision or where the pools have closed down, as free lessons are not much use if there's no place to have them?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Mae dysgu nofio yn un o'r rhoddion gorau y gallwch eu rhoi i blentyn. Cefais y fraint o nofio yn llynnoedd Hampstead Heath, y Serpentine, Llyn Bled, oddi ar Ynys Skye ac ar hyd rhan helaeth o'r arfordir gorllewinol, ac un diwrnod rwy'n bwriadu cymryd rhan mewn ‘nofiothon’ eto. Mae'n sgil y gallwch ei chadw am oes, mae'n mynd â chi i leoedd na fyddech chi byth yn breuddwydio amdanynt ac yn mynd â chi o amgylch y byd. Ond nid yw pob plentyn yn cael y budd o ddechrau o’r fath. Canfu Nofio Cymru mai dim ond 42 y cant o blant ym mlynyddoedd 3 i 6 oedd yn gallu nofio 25 metr heb gymorth, sy'n ffigur difrifol i wlad â'n harfordir ni, ac mae'n fater diogelwch hefyd. Felly, rwy'n croesawu'r rhaglen hon, ond a allai'r Gweinidog Cabinet amlinellu sut y bydd yn mynd i'r afael â dysgu plant mewn ardaloedd lle nad oes llawer o ddarpariaeth neu lle mae pyllau nofio wedi cau, gan nad yw gwersi am ddim o fawr werth os nad oes lle i'w cynnal.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Diolch. Dyna yn union pam dŷn ni'n edrych ar gyfleusterau ledled Cymru hefyd, a dyna pam dŷn ni'n dechrau efo naw awdurdod lleol sydd mewn gwahanol rannau o Gymru—rhai yn wledig, lle mae yna byllau nofio wedi cau—i ddeall yr heriau hynny a deall sut dŷn ni'n blaenoriaethu buddsoddiad. Dŷn ni yn gwybod ar y funud mai dim ond 13 y cant o blant dan 11 oed sy'n cymryd gwersi nofio allgyrsiol. Dŷn ni hefyd yn gwybod bod yna filoedd o blant yn gadael ysgol gynradd bob blwyddyn sy'n methu â nofio.

Mae hi yn sgìl sy'n gallu achub bywyd. Mae hi yn sgìl sy'n gallu eich cadw chi'n actif drwy gydol eich oes, oherwydd mae'n un o'r unig chwaraeon dŷch chi yn gallu eu gwneud dim ots pa oed ydych chi hefyd. Felly, dyna pam dŷn ni wedi ymrwymo i hyn, ac mi oedd o'n wych gweld, mewn ymweliad diweddar gyda'r Prif Weinidog, y gwersi hyn ar waith, a gweld hyd yn oed y plant hynny oedd yn gallu nofio yn datblygu eu sgiliau o ran achub bywyd a hefyd beth i wneud mewn sefyllfa os oedden nhw'n disgyn i'r dŵr heb rybudd neu mewn cyfleusterau lle mae'r dŵr yn oer iawn neu i ddeall y peryglon. Dydy o ddim jest yn fater o ddysgu pobl i nofio, ond dysgu'r sgiliau all arbed bywyd hefyd.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Thank you. That is exactly why we are looking at facilities across Wales, and that is why we are starting with nine local authorities in different parts of Wales—some rural, where swimming pools have closed down—to understand those challenges and to understand how we prioritise investment. We do know at the moment that only 13 per cent of children under 11 do take swimming lessons on an extracurricular basis. We also know that there are thousands of children that leave primary school every year being unable to swim.

It is a skill that can save lives. It's a skill that can keep you active throughout your life as well, because it's one of the few sports that you can do at any age. So, that is why we are committed to this, and it was wonderful to see, at a recent visit with the First Minister, these lessons being provided, and seeing even those children who could already swim developing their skills in terms of saving lives and what to do in a position if they were to fall into water unexpectedly or in facilities where the water is very cold, so that they understood the dangers. It's not just a matter of learning to swim, but learning life-saving skills too.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Sports Facilities

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: 7. A wnaiff y Gweinidog Cabinet roi diweddariad ar archwiliad Chwaraeon Cymru o gyfleusterau chwaraeon rhanbarthol a chymunedol? OQ64715
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: 7. Will the Cabinet Minister provide an update on the Sport Wales audit of regional and community sports facilities? OQ64715

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch i'r Aelod. Mae'r gwaith hwn yn mynd rhagddo yn adolygu'r wybodaeth sy'n cael ei gadw gan gyrff llywodraethu, awdurdodau lleol a phartneriaid eraill i greu darlun cenedlaethol o gyfleusterau chwaraeon cymunedol, rhanbarthol a chenedlaethol ledled Cymru. Mae'r gwaith cychwynnol hwn yn dechrau nodi bylchau yn y dystiolaeth ac yn datblygu opsiynau ar gyfer cyflwyno a chynnal y data, gan helpu i lywio buddsoddiad cyfalaf mwy strategol yn y dyfodol.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: I thank the Member. This work is going ahead, reviewing the information held by governing bodies, local authorities and other partners to build a national picture of community, regional and national sports facilities across Wales. This initial work will start by identifying gaps in the evidence and developing options for presenting and maintaining the data, helping to inform future strategic capital investment.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Cefn Fforest Leisure Centre remains open, but Caerphilly council significantly reduced its opening hours in 2025 and closed the fitness suite. Will the Sport Wales data capture include changes to opening hours, the facility availability at each site and the distance to alternative provision, so that the future capital investment reflects the level of provision communities have access to?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Mae Canolfan Hamdden Cefn Fforest yn parhau i fod ar agor, ond fe wnaeth Cyngor Caerffili leihau ei horiau agor yn sylweddol yn 2025 a chau'r ystafell ffitrwydd. A fydd y broses casglu data gan Chwaraeon Cymru yn cynnwys newidiadau i oriau agor, argaeledd y cyfleuster ym mhob safle, a'r pellter i ddarpariaeth amgen, fel bod buddsoddiad cyfalaf yn y dyfodol yn adlewyrchu lefel y ddarpariaeth sydd ar gael i gymunedau?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Mae'r cam cyntaf yn edrych ar y lleoliadau. Dŷn ni hefyd yn edrych ar ba ddata ychwanegol sydd ar gael, gan gynnwys oriau agor ac ati. Yr hyn sydd yn anodd ar y funud ydy bod gennym ni ddim darlun llawn er mwyn deall beth ydy'r rhwystrau a beth ydy'r pethau all newid a lle byddai buddsoddiad yn neud y gwahaniaeth. Felly, mae'r gwaith hwnnw'n mynd rhagddo ac mi fyddaf i'n sicrhau fy mod i wedi codi efo Chwaraeon Cymru yr hyn dŷch chi wedi ei godi heddiw, i sicrhau bod oriau agor yn rhan o hynny, er mwyn inni allu gweld y darlun mwyaf llawn posibl. Mae yna heriau, oherwydd mae rhai awdurdodau lleol efo'r data hwn, ond dŷn ni'n gwybod bod lot o awdurdodau lleol hefyd wedi 'outsource-io' rhai o'r gwasanaethau hyn, felly mae o yn anodd cael at y data, ond dŷn ni yn trio cael darlun mor llawn ag sy'n bosibl.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: The initial phase is looking at the sites. We are also looking at what additional data is available, including on opening hours and so forth. What's difficult at the moment is that we don't have a full picture in order to be able to understand what the barriers are and what are the things that could change and where investment would make that difference. So, that work is going ahead, and I will ensure that I have raised with Sport Wales what you've raised today, to ensure that opening hours form part of that, so that we can try and see the fullest possible picture. There are challenges, because some local authorities hold this data, but we know that a lot of local authorities also have outsourced some of these services, so it is difficult to access that data in some cases, but we are trying to get the fullest possible picture.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch. A'r cwestiwn olaf, Weinidog, cwestiwn 8, Safa Elhassan.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Thank you. The final question, Minister, question 8, Safa Elhassan.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Access to Cultural, Sporting and Recreational Activities

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: 8. Pa gamau mae Llywodraeth Cymru yn eu cymryd i wella mynediad at weithgareddau diwylliannol, chwaraeon a hamdden yng Ngŵyr Abertawe? OQ64707
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: 8. What action is the Welsh Government taking to improve access to cultural, sporting and recreational activities in Gŵyr Abertawe? OQ64707

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Mae Llywodraeth Cymru, a minnau fel Gweinidog, wedi ymrwymo i sicrhau bod diwylliant a chwaraeon yn hygyrch i bawb. Drwy'r gwaith ar ddatblygu strategaeth diwylliant a chwaraeon, rydyn ni'n edrych ar sut y gallwn ni gefnogi'r nod hwnnw. Drwy'r alwad am dystiolaeth, dŷn ni eisiau clywed gan bobl ledled Cymru, gan gynnwys yng Ngŵyr Abertawe, er mwyn sicrhau bod ystod eang o leisiau a phrofiadau yn llywio'r modd mae pobl yn cael mynediad at ddiwylliant, y celfyddydau a chwaraeon.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: The Welsh Government, and myself as Minister, are committed to ensuring that culture and sport are accessible to everyone. he work on developing a new culture and sport strategy for Wales is enabling us to look at how we can support that aim. Through the call for evidence, we want to hear from people in communities across Wales, including in Gŵyr Abertawe, ensuring that a broad range of voices and experiences helps shape how culture, the arts and sport are accessed and experienced.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Diolch, Minister. On a recent visit to Sketty Youth Club, alongside the Cabinet Secretary for Education and the Welsh Language, I saw first-hand how a welcoming community centre can bring children, parents and grandparents together through outdoor activities. Groups such as Sketty Tea Lounge 50-plus club also show how important it is to create opportunities for older people to stay active, connected and engaged.

In Swansea bay, the HARBWR project provides another excellent example, using creative and cultural activities to support people experiencing loneliness and poor mental health. As a clinician, I know that prevention starts long before someone reaches a hospital or a GP surgery.

How will the culture and sports strategy help bring community organisations and health services together, so that more people across Gŵyr Abertawe can benefit from affordable cultural and recreational activities to improve well-being and help prevent ill health?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Diolch, Weinidog. Ar ymweliad diweddar â Chlwb Ieuenctid Sgeti yng nghwmni Ysgrifennydd y Cabinet dros Addysg a’r Gymraeg, gwelais drosof fy hun sut y gall canolfan gymunedol groesawgar ddod â phlant, rhieni a neiniau a theidiau at ei gilydd trwy weithgareddau awyr agored. Mae grwpiau fel clwb Lolfa De Sgeti i rai dros 50 oed hefyd yn dangos pa mor bwysig yw creu cyfleoedd i bobl hŷn aros yn egnïol, mewn cysylltiad ac yn rhan o bethau.

Ym mae Abertawe, mae prosiect HARBWR yn enghraifft ragorol arall, gan ddefnyddio gweithgareddau creadigol a diwylliannol i gefnogi pobl sy’n profi unigrwydd ac iechyd meddwl gwael. Fel clinigydd, gwn fod atal yn dechrau ymhell cyn i rywun gyrraedd ysbyty neu feddygfa.

Sut y bydd y strategaeth diwylliant a chwaraeon yn helpu i ddod â sefydliadau cymunedol a gwasanaethau iechyd at ei gilydd fel y gall mwy o bobl ar draws ardal Gŵyr Abertawe elwa o weithgareddau diwylliannol a hamdden fforddiadwy er mwyn gwella llesiant a helpu i atal salwch?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i'r Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Diolch i'r Aelod. Mae'n wych clywed am y pethau rhagorol sydd yn digwydd yn eich etholaeth chi, a dwi wir yn mwynhau clywed am yr esiamplau hyn. Dyna pam y mae o yn bwysig bod pawb ohonon ni yn cyfrannu y syniadau hyn a'r enghreifftiau hyn i ddatblygiad y strategaeth, fel ein bod ni'n edrych ar sicrhau'r cysondeb hwnnw. Dwi'n gobeithio bod yr ymrwymiad dŷch chi wedi'i glywed gen i eto heddiw, ymrwymiadau dŷch chi wedi eu clywed gan y Gweinidog Cabinet dros iechyd a'r ddwy Ddirprwy Weinidogion o ran iechyd, hefyd yn dangos ein bod ni yn gweithio ar y cyd o ran y mater yma.

Dwi wedi cael llond bol, a dwi wedi dweud yn rheolaidd, o ddarllen adroddiadau sydd yn dweud bod angen i Gymru symud at agenda ataliol, fod yn rhaid i'r gwaith hwnnw ddechrau, ac mae'r gwaith hwnnw wedi dechrau. Mae'n mynd i gymryd amser i newid y systemau, ond mae'n rhaid i ni ei wneud. Dŷn ni'n gwybod bod diwylliant a chwaraeon yn cael effaith gadarnhaol ar iechyd corfforol ac iechyd meddyliol, felly y gwaith dŷn ni'n ei wneud rŵan ydy ar sut dŷn ni'n sicrhau bod yr holl systemau sydd wedi gweithredu ar wahân yn cyd-fynd, a'n bod ni'n gallu cael potensial diwylliant a chwaraeon wedi'i wireddu o ran iechyd, o ran yr economi ac o ran dyfodol ein cenedl.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
I thank the Member. It's wonderful to hear about the excellent things happening in your constituency, and I do enjoy hearing of these examples. That's why it is so important that all of us do contribute these ideas and these examples to the development of the strategy, so that we seek to ensure that consistency. I do hope that the commitment that you've heard from me again today, commitments that you've heard from the Cabinet Minister for health and the two Deputy Ministers on health, also does demonstrate that we are working together on this issue.

I've had enough, and I've said regularly, having read reports that say that Wales needs to move towards a preventative agenda, that that work has to start, and it has started. It will take time to change systems, but we have to do it. We know that culture and sports do have a positive impact on physical and mental health, so the work we're doing now is to look at how we can ensure that all of the systems that have operated in silos can concord, and that we can get the potential of culture and sport delivered in terms of health, in terms of the economy and in terms of the future of our nation.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Finance
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: 1. A wnaiff y Gweinidog Cabinet ddarparu diweddariad ar adolygiad o'r fformiwla ariannu llywodraeth leol? OQ64711
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: 1. Will the Cabinet Minister provide an update on the review of the local government funding formula? OQ64711

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Gyllid
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Finance
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Mae'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Lywodraeth Leol, Tai a Chynllunio yn bwrw ymlaen â'r adolygiad o fformiwla ariannu llywodraeth leol mewn partneriaeth â llywodraeth leol. Mae hyn yn cynnwys gwaith technegol ar y cyd gyda llywodraeth leol ac ymchwil annibynnol drwy Ganolfan Polisi Cyhoeddus Cymru. Mae disgwyl adroddiad yn ystod haf 2027 ar y gwaith yma.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: The Cabinet Minister for Local Government, Housing and Planning is proceeding with the local government funding formula review in partnership with local authorities. This includes joint technical work with local government and independent research through the Wales Centre for Public Policy. We're expecting a report during the summer of 2027 on this work.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Gyllid
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Finance
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch yn fawr. Fel cyn-gynghorydd sir o 14 o flynyddoedd, croesawaf ymrwymiad y Llywodraeth hon i adnewyddu'r berthynas rhwng Llywodraeth Cymru ac awdurdodau lleol drwy sicrhau eu bod nhw'n bartneriaid llawn yn nyluniad a darpariaeth gwasanaethau cyhoeddus. Mae awdurdodau lleol yn gwneud gwaith rhagorol ar draws ein cymunedau, a byddwn yn dibynnu arnynt i gyflawni llawer o flaenoriaethau'r Llywodraeth hon. Mae'n hanfodol felly fod y fformiwla ariannu yn adlewyrchu cost go iawn darparu gwasanaethau mewn gwahanol rannau o Gymru. A allai'r Gweinidog felly ddarparu gwybodaeth am ba drafodaethau mae hi wedi'u cael gyda'r Gweinidog Llywodraeth Leol, Tai a Chynllunio a Chymdeithas Llywodraeth Leol Cymru ynglŷn â'r mater yma? Diolch.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Thank you very much. As a former county councillor of 14 years, I welcome this Government's commitment to renewing the relationship between the Welsh Government and local authorities by ensuring that they are full partners in the design and the delivery of public services. Local authorities do excellent work across our communities, and we will rely on them to deliver many of this Government's priorities. It is therefore essential that the funding formula reflects the true cost of service delivery in different parts of Wales. Could the Minister therefore provide information on the discussions she has had with the Minister for Local Government, Housing and Planning and with the Welsh Local Government Association regarding this matter? Thank you.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Gyllid
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Finance
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Diolch am y cwestiwn pellach yna, ac a gaf i gytuno gyda'r Aelod fod cynghorau sir yng Nghymru yn chwarae rhan allweddol o ran delifro gwasanaethau cyhoeddus ac yn chwarae rôl hanfodol o ran sut bydd y Llywodraeth yma'n gwireddu ein rhaglen lywodraethu ni, ac yn chwarae rhan allweddol, wrth gwrs, yn darparu a chynrychioli'r bobl yn lleol? Ac felly mae ariannu llywodraeth leol, i'w galluogi nhw i fedru cyflawni yn y modd yma, yn bwysig yn hynny o beth.

Cwestiwn ynglŷn â'r drafodaeth dwi wedi ei chael gyda'r Gweinidog llywodraeth leol o ran ariannu priodol ar gyfer awdurdodau lleol—ie, yn sicr, mae hynny'n digwydd fel rhan o'r drafodaeth ynglŷn â pharatoi ar gyfer cyllideb flynyddol Cymru. Ac, wythnos ddiwethaf dwi'n meddwl oedd hi, fe wnes i gwrdd, ar y cyd â'r Gweinidog llywodraeth leol, gydag awdurdodau lleol yn finance sub-group yr WLGA wrth i ni drafod y gyllideb flynyddol, ie, a newidiadau a'r drafodaeth ynglŷn â'r fformiwla cyllido hefyd. Felly, mae'r berthynas a'r drafodaeth barhaus yna gyda llywodraeth leol yn bwysig iawn i'r Llywodraeth yma er mwyn cyflawni'r holl waith mae'n cynghorau sir ni yn gyfrifol am ei wneud.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Thank you for that supplementary question, and may I agree with the Member that county councils in Wales play a crucial role in delivering public services and play a crucial role in terms of how this Government will deliver its programme for government, and they play a key role, of course, in providing for and representing people at a local level? So, the funding of local government to allow them to deliver in that way is important in that regard.

Now, there was a question on the discussions that I've been having with the Minister for local government in terms of appropriate funding for local authorities—yes, certainly, that is happening as part of the discussions around the preparation of the annual budget for Wales. Last week, I believe, I met, along with the Minister for local government, with local authorities in the WLGA finance sub-group as we discussed the annual budget, and changes and the discussion around the funding formula too. So, that ongoing relationship and discussion with local government is very important to this Government in order to deliver all of the work that our county councils are responsible for doing.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Gyllid
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Finance
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Cabinet Minister, whilst your colleague is in America deep-seeking the meaning of artificial intelligence, and the First Minister is running around Cardiff market, there are some very pressing challenges in Carmarthenshire affecting rural communities. Cash-strapped councils are being forced into short-term, penny-pinching false economies like threatening to close our small rural schools. In fact, two schools were closed today. Councils must manage their money, yes, I absolutely agree, but when will the Welsh Government prioritise ours? Will this funding formula finally direct real taxpayers' money to safeguard these small rural schools, the beating hearts of our communities? Diolch.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Weinidog Cabinet, tra bod eich cyd-Aelod yn America yn archwilio ystyr deallusrwydd artiffisial a'r Prif Weinidog yn rhedeg o gwmpas marchnad Caerdydd, mae yna heriau dybryd iawn yn sir Gaerfyrddin yn effeithio ar gymunedau gwledig. Mae cynghorau sy'n brin o arian yn cael eu gorfodi i droi at economïau ffug tymor byr, crintachlyd fel bygwth cau ein hysgolion bach gwledig. Fe gaewyd dwy ysgol heddiw a dweud y gwir. Rhaid i gynghorau reoli eu harian, rwy'n cytuno'n llwyr, ond pryd fydd Llywodraeth Cymru yn blaenoriaethu ein harian ni? A fydd y fformiwla ariannu hon o'r diwedd yn cyfeirio arian trethdalwyr tuag at ddiogelu'r ysgolion bach gwledig hyn, calonnau ein cymunedau? Diolch.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Gyllid
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Finance
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Well, the promotion of Wales overseas is an important aspect of the work that this Government wants to accomplish on behalf of businesses and communities in Wales. The First Minister was drinking a cup of coffee in a corridor as I passed him on the way down to the Chamber earlier, gallivanting nowhere at that point, hot coffee in his hand. Can I just say that, as I answered Rebeca earlier, local authorities provide a really key role in being able to deliver services—education, social services—in all our communities in Wales? They face tough, challenging budgetary situations, as we do as a national Government as well. Taking these decisions at a local level is important. We believe in the decentralisation of decision making in Wales, not setting arbitrary caps on local authorities in terms of the money that they have the ability to spend, as you will want to propose later on this afternoon. They have to take difficult decisions. I represent a constituency west of yours, also rural in nature. I've seen local schools at times have to be closed; I've seen campaigns to save local schools, and those local schools remain open today. These are complex decisions that local communities and their representatives have to take, and should not be trivialised in this place; they need to follow the processes, listen to the voices of those people involved, and take the right decisions. It's not for us to dictate the decisions that should be taken locally.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Wel, mae hyrwyddo Cymru dramor yn agwedd bwysig ar y gwaith y mae'r Llywodraeth hon am ei gyflawni ar ran busnesau a chymunedau yng Nghymru. Roedd y Prif Weinidog yn yfed paned o goffi mewn coridor wrth imi fynd heibio iddo ar fy ffordd i lawr i'r Siambr yn gynharach, nid yn galifantio i unman ar y pryd, a choffi poeth yn ei law. A gaf i ddweud, fel y dywedais wrth Rebeca yn gynharach, fod awdurdodau lleol yn chwarae rhan hollbwysig yn darparu gwasanaethau—addysg a gwasanaethau cymdeithasol—yn ein holl gymunedau yng Nghymru? Maent yn wynebu sefyllfaoedd cyllidebol anodd a heriol, yn union fel ninnau fel Llywodraeth genedlaethol. Mae gwneud y penderfyniadau hyn ar lefel leol yn bwysig. Credwn mewn datganoli'r broses o wneud penderfyniadau yng Nghymru, yn hytrach na gosod terfynau mympwyol ar awdurdodau lleol o ran faint o arian y gallant ei wario, fel y byddwch chi am ei gynnig yn ddiweddarach y prynhawn yma. Rhaid iddynt wneud penderfyniadau anodd. Rwy'n cynrychioli etholaeth i'r gorllewin o'ch un chi, sydd hefyd yn un wledig ei natur. Rwyf wedi gweld ysgolion lleol yn gorfod cau ar adegau; rwyf wedi gweld ymgyrchoedd i achub ysgolion lleol, ac mae'r ysgolion hynny'n parhau ar agor heddiw. Mae cymunedau lleol a’u cynrychiolwyr yn gorfod gwneud y penderfyniadau cymhleth hyn, ac ni ddylid eu bychanu yn y lle hwn; mae angen iddynt ddilyn y prosesau, gwrando ar leisiau'r bobl, a gwneud y penderfyniadau cywir. Nid ein lle ni yw gwneud y penderfyniadau y dylid eu gwneud yn lleol.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Gyllid
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Finance

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Gyllid
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Finance
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: The key drivers of demand on local authority budgets include population, school numbers, social care and deprivation. Any changes to the weighting of these indicators in the local government funding formula will have a huge impact on the ability of councils with the greatest population density and deprivation to deliver essential services. Following the Welsh Government's recent deviation from the established funding formula, councils with the highest levels of deprivation do need clarity. They need to know whether any lasting changes to the formula will come with any significant extra funding or will the funding pot still be the same.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Mae'r prif ffactorau sy'n sbarduno'r galw ar gyllidebau awdurdodau lleol yn cynnwys poblogaeth, niferoedd ysgolion, gofal cymdeithasol ac amddifadedd. Bydd unrhyw newidiadau i bwysoli'r dangosyddion hyn yn fformiwla ariannu llywodraeth leol yn cael effaith enfawr ar allu cynghorau sydd â'r dwysedd poblogaeth a'r amddifadedd mwyaf i ddarparu gwasanaethau hanfodol. Yn dilyn gwyriad diweddar Llywodraeth Cymru o'r fformiwla ariannu sefydledig, mae angen eglurder ar y cynghorau sydd â'r lefelau uchaf o amddifadedd. Mae angen iddynt wybod a fydd unrhyw newidiadau parhaol i'r fformiwla yn dod ag unrhyw gyllid ychwanegol sylweddol neu a fydd y pot ariannu yn dal yr un fath.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Gyllid
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Finance
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Thank you. You outline the challenges, of course, with the creation of a funding formula that works for all communities and all local authorities across Wales, as diverse as they are for us in Wales. The review that is now being undertaken, part of it in direct partnership and in collaboration with local government, the technical review, part of that is updating and recalibrating the formula while retaining its established needs-based methodology, and initial work that's currently ongoing is focused on some of the areas you've identified, and they are the main areas of local government delivery, and they are on education and personal social services.

As I said in my initial answer, then, this work is ongoing and it is in partnership with local authorities. The final report on this work will be next summer, and that will then decide how we move forward on these issues. I suspect we'll have many conversations around these issues both here, but, importantly, between ourselves as a Government and local government, which are the essential deliverers of so many aspects of our public services and need to be funded according to the need that they need to deliver in a variety of different circumstances.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Diolch. Rydych chi'n amlinellu'r heriau, wrth gwrs, wrth greu fformiwla ariannu sy'n gweithio i bob cymuned a phob awdurdod lleol ledled Cymru, yn eu holl amrywiaeth. Mae’r adolygiad sy'n cael ei gynnal ar hyn o bryd, gyda rhan ohono mewn partneriaeth uniongyrchol ac mewn cydweithrediad â llywodraeth leol, yr adolygiad technegol, mae rhan o hwnnw’n cynnwys diweddaru ac ailraddnodi'r fformiwla tra'n cadw ei fethodoleg sefydledig sy'n seiliedig ar anghenion, ac mae'r gwaith cychwynnol sy'n mynd rhagddo ar hyn o bryd yn canolbwyntio ar rai o'r meysydd rydych chi wedi'u nodi, prif feysydd darpariaeth llywodraeth leol, sef addysg a gwasanaethau cymdeithasol personol. 

Fel y dywedais yn fy ateb cychwynnol, mae'r gwaith hwn yn parhau ac yn cael ei wneud mewn partneriaeth ag awdurdodau lleol. Bydd yr adroddiad terfynol ar y gwaith hwn yn barod yr haf nesaf, a bydd hwnnw wedyn yn penderfynu sut rydym yn bwrw ymlaen â'r materion hyn. Rwy'n tybio y byddwn yn cael llawer o sgyrsiau am y materion hyn yma, ac yn bwysig, rhyngom ni fel Llywodraeth a llywodraeth leol, sef prif ddarparwyr cymaint o agweddau ar ein gwasanaethau cyhoeddus, ac mae angen eu hariannu’n unol â'r anghenion y mae angen iddynt eu diwallu mewn amrywiaeth o amgylchiadau gwahanol.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Gyllid
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Finance
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: 2. Pa drafodaethau mae'r Gweinidog Cabinet wedi'u cael gyda Thrysorlys Ei Fawrhydi a Chyllid a Thollau ei Fawrhydi ynglŷn ag effaith bosibl taliadau arfaethedig Cynnal Llywodraeth Cymru ar statws treth a budd-daliadau y rhai sy'n ei gael? OQ64718
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: 2. What discussions has the Cabinet Minister had with HM Treasury and HMRC regarding the potential impact of the Welsh Government’s proposed Cynnal payments on recipients’ tax and benefits status? OQ64718

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Gyllid
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Finance
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Dwi wedi ysgrifennu at y Canghellor ac Ysgrifennydd Ariannol y Trysorlys i ofyn am esemptiad treth ar gyfer Cynnal. Dwi hefyd wedi codi'r mater mewn cyfarfod â Phrif Ysgrifennydd y Trysorlys. Mewn trafodaethau gyda'r Gweinidog Gwladol ar gyfer yr Adran Gwaith a Phensiynau, mae'r Dirprwy Brif Weinidog hefyd wedi gwneud cais i'r taliad gael ei ddiystyru at ddibenion cyfrifo budd-daliadau. Dwi'n croesawu hefyd, yn hyn o beth, sylwadau cadarnhaol Prif Weinidog newydd y Deyrnas Gyfunol o ran edrych ymhellach ar y materion yma.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: I have written to the Chancellor and Financial Secretary to the Treasury to request a tax exemption for Cynnal. I've also raised the issue in a meeting with the Chief Secretary to the Treasury. In discussions with the Minister of State in the Department for Work and Pensions, the Deputy First Minister has also requested that the payment be disregarded for benefits calculation purposes. I also welcome the Prime Minister's positive comments to explore these matters further.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Gyllid
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Finance
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch. On average, across Wales, around one in three children live in poverty, with some of the most deprived wards found in Clwyd, which is where I represent. We often talk about food poverty and fuel poverty, but I want to draw the Siambr's attention to another less visible consequence of poverty, and that is bed poverty. Too many children are sleeping in broken or unsuitable beds, having to share beds or regularly sleeping on sofas, chairs or even floors because they simply cannot afford an adequate bed. Sleep deprivation can affect almost every major system of the body. The introduction of the Cynnal payment is obviously very welcome, but we must ensure that this does not affect other means-tested benefits. Furthermore, if we're serious about creating lasting change for children living in poverty, we need the powers to tackle that poverty ourselves. I understand from news sources that there's been some discussion around this, but will the Minister commit to not only continuing discussions with the relevant departments to ensure Cynnal payments do not affect means-tested benefits, but also to pressing the UK Government for the full devolution of welfare powers to Wales?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Diolch. Ar gyfartaledd, ledled Cymru, mae tua un o bob tri o blant yn byw mewn tlodi, gyda rhai o'r wardiau mwyaf difreintiedig i'w gweld yng Nghlwyd, lle rwy'n ei gynrychioli. Rydym yn aml yn siarad am dlodi bwyd a thlodi tanwydd, ond rwyf am dynnu sylw'r Siambr at un o ganlyniadau eraill llai gweladwy tlodi, sef tlodi gwelyau. Mae gormod o blant yn cysgu mewn gwelyau sydd wedi torri neu'n anaddas, yn gorfod rhannu gwelyau neu'n cysgu'n rheolaidd ar soffas, cadeiriau neu hyd yn oed ar loriau am nad ydynt yn gallu fforddio gwely addas. Gall colli cwsg effeithio ar bron pob system fawr yn y corff. Mae cyflwyno'r taliad Cynnal yn amlwg i'w groesawu'n fawr, ond rhaid inni sicrhau nad yw'n effeithio ar fudd-daliadau eraill sy'n amodol ar brawf modd. Ar ben hynny, os ydym o ddifrif am greu newid parhaol i blant sy'n byw mewn tlodi, mae angen pwerau arnom i fynd i'r afael â'r tlodi hwnnw ein hunain. Rwy'n deall o ffynonellau newyddion fod rhywfaint o drafod wedi bod ynglŷn â hyn, ond a wnaiff y Gweinidog ymrwymo nid yn unig i barhau â thrafodaethau gyda'r adrannau perthnasol i sicrhau nad yw taliadau Cynnal yn effeithio ar fudd-daliadau sy'n dibynnu ar brawf modd, ond hefyd i bwyso ar Lywodraeth y DU am ddatganoli pwerau lles yn llawn i Gymru?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Gyllid
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Finance
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Thank you. You outline in your question the real, debilitating impact of poverty on children in our communities, and that's why this Government is seeking to introduce a child poverty payment, direct payment, in the form of our Cynnal scheme. It will be very difficult for us as a Government to introduce that pilot if we are not given those exemptions to benefits by the UK Government, so we are pursuing vigorously a decision by the UK Government to exempt the Cynnal payment from any impact on benefits or taxes. So, we will be pursuing those. And I'm hoping, even in my letter to the UK Government, that this could be something the UK Government provides clarity on in the budget in April. And just to say, in terms of the full devolution of welfare—or progress on the devolution of welfare—then that is certainly something that the First Minister is pursuing as part of the need to see greater devolution. We've seen how the part devolution of welfare for Scotland has enabled a child poverty payment to be made in Scotland, and we are prevented from doing so at this point by some of the restrictions around our devolution settlement. So, we need to change that in order to help us with the work that we want to tackle in terms of child poverty.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Diolch. Rydych chi'n amlinellu yn eich cwestiwn effaith wirioneddol a gwanychol tlodi ar blant yn ein cymunedau, a dyna pam y mae'r Llywodraeth hon yn ceisio cyflwyno taliad tlodi plant, taliad uniongyrchol, ar ffurf ein cynllun Cynnal. Fe fydd yn anodd iawn i ni fel Llywodraeth gyflwyno'r cynllun peilot hwnnw os na roddir yr eithriadau hynny i fudd-daliadau gan Lywodraeth y DU, felly rydym yn gwasgu'n galed am benderfyniad gan Lywodraeth y DU i eithrio taliad Cynnal rhag unrhyw effaith ar fudd-daliadau neu drethi. Felly, byddwn yn mynd ar drywydd hynny. Ac rwy'n gobeithio, hyd yn oed yn fy llythyr at Lywodraeth y DU, y gallai hyn fod yn rhywbeth y mae Llywodraeth y DU yn darparu eglurder yn ei gylch yn y gyllideb ym mis Ebrill. Ac os caf ddweud, o ran datganoli lles llawn—neu gynnydd ar ddatganoli lles—mae hynny'n sicr yn rhywbeth y mae'r Prif Weinidog yn mynd ar ei drywydd yn rhan o'r angen i weld mwy o ddatganoli. Rydym wedi gweld sut y mae datganoli lles yn rhannol i'r Alban wedi ei gwneud hi'n bosibl gwneud taliad tlodi plant yn yr Alban, ac fe gawn ni ein hatal rhag gwneud hynny ar hyn o bryd gan rai o'r cyfyngiadau yn ein setliad datganoli. Felly, mae angen inni newid hynny er mwyn ein helpu gyda'r gwaith yr hoffem fynd i'r afael ag ef ar dlodi plant.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Gyllid
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Finance
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Minister, Labour rejected your supplementary budget in July. Mark Drakeford suggested that they should have accepted the deal. And now, Labour and Plaid have reached an agreement. The old band is back together, playing live on the stage of failed promises. [Interruption.] Your defeated budget proposed £2 million for Cynnal payments, but up to 15,000 children could be affected, and that would cost £7.8 million over a year before administration costs.

As recently as 7 October, you were still seeking safeguards from HM Revenue and Customs and the Department for Work and Pensions to prevent families losing out through tax or reduced benefits. It's good to hear your statement, but why on earth announce financial help before securing the protections needed to ensure recipients actually benefit? That looks short-sighted and publicity-seeking. Does this risk become another disingenuous Plaid manifesto promise scuppered by inadequate preparation and uncertainty over funding? Minister, does your agreement with Labour fund the financial support needed to deliver Cynnal from the first payment and beyond the original £2 million budget? Thank you.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Weinidog, gwrthododd Llafur eich cyllideb atodol ym mis Gorffennaf. Awgrymodd Mark Drakeford y dylent fod wedi derbyn y cytundeb. A nawr, mae Llafur a Phlaid Cymru wedi dod i gytundeb. Mae'r hen fand yn ôl gyda'i gilydd, yn chwarae'n fyw ar lwyfan o addewidion gwag. [Torri ar draws.] Cynigiai eich cyllideb a drechwyd £2 filiwn ar gyfer taliadau Cynnal, ond gallai hyd at 15,000 o blant gael eu heffeithio, a byddai hynny'n costio £7.8 miliwn dros flwyddyn cyn costau gweinyddol.

Mor ddiweddar â 7 Hydref, roeddech chi'n dal i geisio amddiffyniadau gan Gyllid a Thollau EF a'r Adran Gwaith a Phensiynau i atal teuluoedd rhag bod ar eu colled drwy drethi neu lai o fudd-daliadau. Mae'n dda clywed eich datganiad, ond pam ar y ddaear cyhoeddi cymorth ariannol cyn sicrhau'r amddiffyniadau sydd eu hangen i sicrhau bod derbynwyr yn elwa mewn gwirionedd? Mae hynny'n edrych yn unllygeidiog ac yn ffordd o geisio cyhoeddusrwydd. A oes risg y bydd hyn yn dod yn addewid maniffesto Plaid Cymru anonest arall wedi'i chwalu yn sgil paratoi annigonol ac ansicrwydd ynghylch cyllid? Weinidog, a yw eich cytundeb â Llafur yn ariannu'r cymorth ariannol sydd ei angen i gyflawni Cynnal o'r taliad cyntaf a thu hwnt i'r gyllideb wreiddiol o £2 filiwn? Diolch.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Gyllid
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Finance
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: The Cynnal payment is no longer just a manifesto commitment, it is a pledge of the Government elected by the people of Wales in May. We've moved on from a manifesto, so keep up. The programme for government, of course, wants to implement and, across our work as a Government, tackle child poverty, for the clear reasons outlined by Becca in her earlier question. So, we need to be progressing this. We think that there are very straightforward measures that the UK Government could take to enable us to introduce this payment. Designing the Cynnal payment pilot, as it will be, continues as part of the work of this Government now, and, as I've already outlined, we'll be continuing discussions with the UK Government to enable us to bring it into action.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Nid ymrwymiad maniffesto yn unig yw taliad Cynnal mwyach, mae'n addewid gan y Llywodraeth a etholwyd gan bobl Cymru ym mis Mai. Rydym wedi symud ymlaen o faniffesto, felly daliwch i fyny. Mae'r rhaglen lywodraethu, wrth gwrs, eisiau gweithredu, ac ar draws ein gwaith fel Llywodraeth, mynd i'r afael â thlodi plant, am y rhesymau clir a amlinellwyd gan Becca yn ei chwestiwn cynharach. Felly, mae angen i ni fwrw ymlaen â hyn. Credwn fod yna fesurau syml iawn y gallai Llywodraeth y DU eu cymryd i'n galluogi i gyflwyno'r taliad hwn. Mae llunio cynllun peilot taliadau Cynnal, fel y bydd, yn parhau'n rhan o waith y Llywodraeth hon nawr, ac fel yr amlinellais eisoes, byddwn yn parhau i drafod gyda Llywodraeth y DU i'n galluogi i'w roi ar waith.
